reconciliations.reconciliation_owner_status: Every reconciliation names its owner; an unowned reconciliation is not complete.
reconciliations.replay_authority: Replay proceeds only under recorded replay authority and produces replay evidence.
reconciliations.partial_success_posture: Partial failure is explicit; failed records are quarantined and remain non-authoritative rather than silently dropped.
reconciliations.compensation_limitation: Compensation reverses or offsets a prior effect within declared limits and does not delete governed history.
reconciliations.closure_evidence: An exchange is closed only when its reconciliation is owned, evidenced, and complete.
